description: Google's AI research/notebook tool now exposed programmatically only via Gemini Enterprise as 'NotebookLM Enterprise'.

self_serve: admin/partner approval required - needs Google Cloud project, Gemini Enterprise/NotebookLM Enterprise licensing, admin-provisioned IAM roles
api_surface: REST API (notebooks.create, sources) under Gemini Enterprise; no MCP server found
blocker: only available through paid Gemini Enterprise licensing; free consumer NotebookLM has no public API
